**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Redact multipart import bodies before logging HTTP errors**

When an import containing the newly supported SSH credentials receives an HTTP error, `_log_error()` passes the prepared multipart body to `mask_body()`. This function treats multipart text as URL-encoded data, so the sensitive field names are not recognized and private keys and passphrases remain recoverable in ERROR logs. The request-kwargs masking now covers these fields, but the prepared-body error path still exposes them; a synthetic multipart payload confirms both secrets survive masking. Omit multipart bodies from logs or redact their individual parts using the request Content-Type.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve explicit ordering when deriving a chart's query context**

For newly constructed charts, `add_simple_orderby()` and `add_custom_orderby()` modify only `self.query_context`, but serialization replaces that context using params alone. Consequently, those public methods silently stop affecting saved charts: a table with metric `count` and an explicit ascending order on `campus` is sent with `[['count', false]]` instead. The `automatic_order` argument to metric helpers is likewise discarded. Update the corresponding params ordering controls, or otherwise preserve explicit ordering through derivation, so these methods still affect the payload sent to Superset.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Rewind uploaded files before repeating an authenticated request**

When `import_file()` encounters an expired JWT, session, or CSRF token, the first request has already consumed the open ZIP file while constructing its multipart body. This retry reuses the same `kwargs['files']` streams at EOF, so the authenticated repeat uploads an empty archive and the import fails even though credentials were renewed successfully. Record and restore stream positions before repeating the request, or reuse a buffered request body.

payload.headline: A derivação descarta a ordenação definida pela API pública
payload.before: A ordenação fica no contexto em memória, mas a serialização o substitui por outro derivado exclusivamente de params.
payload.after: O payload serializado deve preservar a ordenação solicitada pelos métodos públicos.
payload.motivation: Evitar que charts sejam salvos silenciosamente com coluna ou direção de ordenação diferentes das solicitadas.
payload.reply: Achado confirmado. Os métodos de ordenação modificam somente query_context, enquanto to_json o substitui pelo contexto derivado de params. Para a tabela descrita, a derivação produz [['count', false]], descartando a ordenação por campus. O defeito surgiu na entrega do PR, em 57af98dc33d7e9591815b2e29d18ab3d00511607, e permanece após a correção de revisão.
payload.ca_dod_impact: Quebra o comportamento dos métodos públicos de ordenação no payload enviado ao Superset.
